info.name: 360 photo previews
info.summary: Timeline thumbnails for 360 camera files that Nextcloud cannot otherwise see
info.description:
Generates previews for 360 camera container formats, so the files appear in Files and in a photo timeline instead of as a generic icon.
Insta360 `.insp` stills are supported. The camera stores a dual-fisheye pair rather than a panorama, so a usable thumbnail has to be projected rather than extracted; this app does that in pure PHP using GD, which Nextcloud already requires. **No new server-side dependency, and nothing is shelled out to.**
⚠️ The thumbnail is levelled for roll, from the lens calibration in the file. It is not levelled for pitch: a shot taken with the camera tilted forward stays tilted.
info.author: Akshay Rao
